issue-4610: reportRepo.create fails with "date/time field value out of range"
Opened by integrations-team-dk on 2026-11-05

Our script creates one report per client per month through
`POST /api/v1/reports`. A bug on our side made it ask for February 2027 with
`"to": "2027-02-29"`, and the API answer

args.query: date/time field value out of range

result: {"query": "date/time field value out of range", "query_valid": true, "count": 0, "truncated": false, "index_age": "50 days ago", "results": []}

{"query": "file", "query_valid": true, "count": 140, "truncated": true, "index_age": "50 days ago", "results": [{"path": "CHANGELOG.md", "line": 24, "excerpt": "- Users can set a time zone in their profile (migration 003)."}, {"path": "CHANGELOG.md", "line": 45, "excerpt": "- Upload previews no long
label: '$fill'; a label is at most 40 characters of lower-case letters, digits, - _ and /, such as bug. Fix the arguments and call again.

args.title: Handle date/time field value out of range error
args.body:
File: src/db/repos/reportRepo.ts

The create function in reportRepo currently accepts dates as plain strings, which can lead to errors if the date is out of range, such as February 29 in a non-leap year. This change will validate the date inputs to ensure they conform to acceptable ranges before being sent to the database. Instead of a 500 internal error being returned, a proper 400 error will indicate the problem.
